notes.notes:
[h3][b]🚍 Schedule update:[/b]
[/h3][p]📢 Bus Bound will arrive in 2026! 🗓🚏[/p][p]Master the flow of traffic in a dense city environment and build trust with your passengers by safely navigating various on-road obstacles. 🚌⬆️👍[/p][p]Unlock new routes and American buses as your actions shape and improve the world around you! 💪
[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/TyqB0gge0rU"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Bus Bound - Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Calling all bus drivers! 🚍[/b]
[/h3][p]Embark on a journey to Emberville with Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21 and Bus Simulator 18, offering a unique and meaningful take on American Bus Transportation. 🚌[/p][p]As you become the citizens' bus hero, you will witness the city evolve before your eyes from the positive impact of your actions, one stop at a time. 🚏[/p][p]Explore and improve a vibrant city with a fleet of authentic vehicles while trying to maintain a good reputation with your passengers. 👍
[/p][previewyoutube="VUjGCh9WTts;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
